questions.decision: Cadence for the release lane (run-quality.sh --release, ~298 s) in standing evidence

options.summary: Run --release in the pre-push clean-clone lane on every push
options.tradeoff: About five minutes per push; last local read before the boundary

options.summary: Run --release once at session start
options.tradeoff: Cheap; a regression made mid-session hides until the next session

options.summary: Add a release_only job to quality-core.yml on push to main
options.tradeoff: No local cost; reads after the push, past the boundary

recommendation.reason: The clean-clone push lane already exists and is the last local read before an irreversible boundary

rejected_alternatives.reason: Mid-session regressions would still hide, which is the #768 failure repeated
Second observer at best; it cannot stop the push it reads

options.summary: Reproduce in the CI shape and make the failing timing tests deterministic
options.tradeoff: Real work per test; closes the class for those tests

options.summary: Dispatch a run on the new tree and record only
options.tradeoff: No fix; workflow_dispatch cannot report recovery (#358)

options.summary: Deselect timing-sensitive tests from the sampler baseline
options.tradeoff: Fastest; violates skipped-is-not-passed

recommendation.reason: A deselected test is a skipped-is-passed and a dispatch run cannot report recovery

answer.reason: Operator sharpened it: a nondeterministic timing test should not exist at all

options.tradeoff: Operator signs each lifecycle event; one checkpoint inside the slice

options.summary: Archive the oldest three score-0/0 lessons now by rule
options.tradeoff: No checkpoint; may archive a lesson this goal cites as a boundary

options.summary: Leave the ledger item out of this goal
options.tradeoff: Three recurred classes stay unreadable next session

recommendation.reason: The archive is a lifecycle event the operator signs and the six pre-2026-08-17 candidates are the obvious shortlist

answer.reason: Operator chose it and required promotion and exclusion both in the same slice

options.summary: Census all of tests/ for wall-clock claims, rewrite or delete each, add a form check

questions.decision: What 'promotion' means for the lesson ledger

options.summary: Seed the three recurred classes as active lessons
options.tradeoff: Cheap; the ledger stays the only memory of a proven lesson

options.summary: Add a graduate lifecycle action: compress a proven lesson into its owning docs page (adding and pruning), event points at that commit
options.tradeoff: Builds the mechanism D38 deferred; docs stay current

recommendation.reason: SCORE_OUTCOMES already maps changed-an-action to graduate with nothing behind it, and this session's third recurrence is D38's reopen trigger

answer.reason: Operator: promotion is compressing into the standing docs, removing what the page no longer needs; the per-lesson decision is made jointly in conversation from the agent's drafted disposition, not by rule, automation, or commit inspection

rejected_alternatives.reason: The ledger would stay the only memory; the operator expects docs to carry proven lessons

questions.decision: Whether slice 4 waits for a scheduled mutation run

options.summary: Push and read the next scheduled cycle when it has happened
options.tradeoff: No blocking; #764 may close in slice 6 or later

options.summary: Block slice 4 until one scheduled run is green
options.tradeoff: Up to 12 hours idle per attempt

options.summary: Let a push-triggered run report recovery
options.tradeoff: Changes the #358 proof-surface rule

recommendation.reason: The schedule is the observer; the slice's claim is the tree, not the run

answer.reason: Operator: no waiting; check on the next cycle

rejected_alternatives.reason: Idle time for no extra evidence
Changes a proof-surface rule for convenience

questions.decision: Whether this goal builds a repo-owned rename-sweep tool that consumes the layout resolver, or only the resolver

options.summary: Build the resolver and fold the three ad hoc lookups onto it; no sweep tool. The next path migration writes its sweep then, calling the resolver.
options.tradeoff: Smallest slice. The sweep-overreach lesson stays a lesson, not a tool; the next migration must remember to consult the resolver.

options.summary: Also build a repo-owned sweep tool (tools/) that rewrites path strings only when the resolver recognises the string as a repo script and knows its new home; skill-tree, $SKILL_DIR, and hash-bound artifact strings are refused by construction.
options.tradeoff: Makes the 2026-09-03 retro's structural fix real now, but builds a tool with no planned migration to use it; risk of a tool that rots before its first use.

recommendation.reason: No migration is planned; a tool without a consumer is speculative, and the resolver is what makes a future sweep safe either way.

answer.reason: Operator approved the recommendation on 2026-09-03 after the sweep explanation

rejected_alternatives.reason: No planned migration would use the tool

questions.decision: Whether a hosted GitHub Actions job runs the release_only tests on push to main as a second observer, in addition to the pre-push clean-clone lane

options.summary: One observer: the pre-push clean-clone lane runs --release; nothing hosted changes.
options.tradeoff: Closes the #768 failure mode (nobody ran the lane before pushing). Does not catch a push that bypassed the hook or came from a machine without the procedure.

options.summary: Add a release_only pytest job to quality-core.yml so GitHub runs it on every push to main; it reads after the push and files or comments on failure.
options.tradeoff: A distinct channel (north star P4) that survives hook bypass; costs about five CI minutes per push and the hosted runner must carry the same preconditions the mutation workflow needed (mirror, PATH, env flag), which is where #764 went wrong.

recommendation.reason: One observer closes the recorded failure; the hosted job inherits the same precondition fragility that broke the mutation baseline and is better decided after slice 4 makes that baseline green.

answer.reason: Operator approved the recommendation on 2026-09-03 after the observer explanation

rejected_alternatives.reason: Inherits the precondition fragility that broke the mutation baseline; decide after slice 4
